name: keenable
description: Keyless web search and page reading for Kiro Crew agents. Adds the Keenable MCP server with search_web_pages and fetch_page_content, plus a skill that tells agents when to search, when to read a page, and how to cite. No account or API key is needed.
author: Keenable
highlights: search_web_pages: ranked web results with page-text snippets
fetch_page_content: any public page as clean markdown
Keyless: the public endpoint needs no account or API key
A skill that tells agents when to search, when to read, and how to cite sources
No backend, install script, cron, or UI: nothing runs on your machine
useCases: Ask an agent to research a topic and cite the pages it used
Check current documentation, releases, or prices that postdate the model
Read a page a teammate pasted into chat as clean markdown
configuration: Install and enable the app; no account or key is needed
The keyless endpoint allows 10 requests per second and 1000 per hour per IP address
